description: Header file defining the MediaCodecSource class, which manages media encoding/decoding, buffer handling, and related operations within Android's media framework.

classes.name: MediaCodecSource
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Android's media codec framework to handle media encoding/decoding, buffer management, and media stream control.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a MediaCodecSource object with specified parameters.

methods.name: isVideo
methods.description: Checks if the media source is video.

methods.name: getGraphicBufferProducer
methods.description: Returns the graphic buffer producer associated with this media source.

methods.name: setInputBufferTimeOffset
methods.description: Sets the time offset for input buffers.

methods.name: getFirstSampleSystemTimeUs
methods.description: Retrieves the system time of the first sample in microseconds.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts media processing with optional parameters.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads media data into a buffer.

methods.name: setStopTimeUs
methods.description: Sets the stop time in microseconds.

methods.name: signalBufferReturned
methods.description: Signals that a media buffer has been returned.

methods.name: requestIDRFrame
methods.description: Requests an IDR (Instantaneous Decoding Refresh) frame.
